compatibility.major: Missing, non-numeric, or unequal majors are incompatible and must fail before filesystem work.
compatibility.minor: Unknown additive fields and higher minor versions are accepted; existing field meanings cannot change within major 1.
compatibility.patch: Clarifications, ABI descriptor advertisement, and additive golden vectors only; no mutation or on-disk semantics change.
compatibility.migration: 1.0.0 freezes existing behavior and adds an additive descriptor to doctor/root reports; no mutation or on-disk semantics change.
compatibility.rollback: Older binaries may ignore the additive report field; stores, journals, refs, and workspaces require no rollback migration.

root.canonicalization: The selected root must exist and be canonicalizable.
root.containment: Compare canonical path components, never string prefixes. Canonicalize existing targets and existing parents of new targets. Reject any link or reparse traversal outside the root.
root.paths: Operation paths are UTF-8 API strings and workspace-relative. Reject absolute, drive-qualified, parent-traversing, and empty normalized paths. Dot denotes root only where explicitly allowed.
root.separators: Host parsing applies. Forward slash is portable; backslash is ordinary on Unix and a separator on Windows. Trailing separators normalize away before kind checks.
root.unicode_case: No Unicode normalization or case folding; host filesystem identity applies.
root.privacy: Capabilities and cross-process telemetry contain no content, credentials, or private absolute roots. Local doctor may show the effective local root.

links.reads: Existing paths follow host canonicalization then root containment.
links.listing: Recursive and glob listing neither traverses nor returns symlinks.
links.writes: Verified edit/write atomically rename-replaces the directory entry, so replacing a symlink replaces the link entry. Rollback follows journaled link targets only with every hop root-checked.
links.hard_links: Host semantics apply. Atomic replacement creates a new inode for that path and does not rewrite sibling hard links.

preserved: readable Unix xattrs on atomic replacement
journaled mtime and Unix mode on rollback
normalized: listing order by rendered relative path

determinism.class_1: Same workspace bytes + same operation parameters produce byte-identical listing manifests (ls/ls_manifest), compound inventory, and content refs for exact file bytes. Entry order is ascending rendered relative path. Re-render must not change listing text when content is unchanged.
determinism.class_2_observed: stat mtime and other live filesystem metadata fields reflect host observation at call time and may change without content change.

reads.full: Binary-safe; returns an immutable ref for exact observed bytes.
reads.partial: path#Bstart-end is zero-based/end-exclusive, clamps to current file length, rejects reversed ranges, and caps one range at 8388608 bytes.
reads.consistency: Separate calls are not a snapshot. Use returned refs plus verified-edit/world preimages for stale-write protection.

traversal.depth: Zero lists direct children; positive values recursively descend directories to the bound.
traversal.budget: A hit stops work and reports budget_hit; it is not a complete result.
traversal.glob: Only *, ?, and ** are portable. Reject classes/braces. Never escape root or traverse links.

mutations.single_file: Sibling temp plus rename gives old-or-new directory-entry visibility where same-directory rename is atomic.
mutations.durability: Atomic visibility is not power-loss durability. Ordinary edit/write does not promise file and parent-directory fsync.
mutations.stale: Verified edit, undo, and world commit reject mismatched preimages without last-writer-wins.
mutations.external: External changes are detected by per-op metadata refresh when no watcher is active, or by watcher events when FSZERO_WATCH=1. Watch is acceleration only: overflow, drain backlog, and truncated rescans mark the index untrusted until reconcile completes, at which point metadata refresh is not short-circuited. Version 1 does not claim multi-process serializability or zero event-loss without reconcile.
mutations.batch: CodeMode applies supported steps and compensates prior edits on failure; unrelated processes may observe intermediate files. Multi-file atomic visibility is not claimed.
mutations.world: Preview is overlay-only; drop leaves base unchanged; commit is preimage-guarded three-way application and rejects overlapping conflicts.
mutations.history: Newest-first durable evidence when a durable store exists. Undo is a new preimage-guarded compensating mutation.
mutations.recovery: Retain evidence and report failed restoration. Full crash-boundary guarantees await the crash-conformance work.

limits.file_size: No independent full-read ceiling; prefer ranges for large files.
limits.path_depth: Host limits and explicit traversal depth apply; no stronger component ceiling.
limits.cancellation: Cancellation observed before publication leaves target unchanged; blocking host syscalls are not all preemptible.
limits.deadline: Deadline observed before publication rejects; durably published work is never reported cancelled.
limits.kinds: Byte operations require openable bounded regular input. FIFOs, sockets, devices, and reparse variants lack mutation guarantees unless capabilities add them.

macos.model: Unix components; volume decides case and normalization.

linux.model: Unix host paths exposed through UTF-8 strings; invalid-UTF-8 names are not portable.

windows.model: Windows components. Inputs remain workspace-relative; reject drive, UNC, and rooted operation paths even when root is drive/UNC.
supported: canonical containment where host canonicalization succeeds
not_claimed: long-path conformance without retained CI evidence

error_classes.invalid_path: Empty, absolute, drive-qualified, or parent-traversing path.
error_classes.unsupported_file_type: No contract for host object kind.
error_classes.stale_preimage: Current state differs from required preimage.
error_classes.conflict: Mutation cannot merge without overwrite ambiguity.

platform.meaning: not representable through public UTF-8 surfaces

roots.condition: target link resolves outside canonical root

links.condition: symlink resolves to regular file inside root

links.outcome: omit entry and do not traverse

metadata.condition: existing regular file has Unix mode
existing xattr is readable and writable

determinism_class1.expect: listing lines sorted ascending; two successive renders equal when tree unchanged
depth listing sorted; budget_hit marker only when truncated
expand of content ref equals exact file bytes

abi.name: fszero-operation-abi
abi.source_of_truth: src/core/operation_abi.rs OPERATION_REGISTRY validated against this document

surfaces.codemode: native METHODS bindings; mutually exclusive install with FastMCP
surfaces.raw_worker: private typed dispatcher for unified ZeroStack composition

parity.invariant: For every canonical op(args), FastMCP, CodeMode single-op, and private raw worker agree on value, typed error kind/retryability, ref identity/bytes, mutation effects, authorization/root policy, cancellation, and telemetry semantics. Transport-only JSON-RPC fields may differ.

abi.schema_ownership: Complete input/output JSON Schema structures for domain ops, MCP tools, CodeMode tools, and CodeMode methods are owned by operation-abi-schemas-v1.json and digested with the ABI.
